responsibility: Collects the public declarations for the Visium backend’s target hooks, RTL expanders, operand helpers, branch/output routines, block operation expanders, and custom pass constructor. It is the interface shared by the Visium headers, machine description, and implementation file so generated patterns and backend code can call prologue/epilogue logic, condition-code selection, cbranch/cstore splitting, trampoline support, scheduling hazard checks, and other target services.
